# automatically guarded: it must earn its correction from context rather
# than firing on every occurrence. Generated by evals/stress/generate.py
# from the committed neutral corpus plus a core everyday-English list.
# In production this would be a proper frequency list; the mechanism is
# what matters, and it is a data file precisely so it can be replaced.
